about: A cov alias that narrows the crates it measures (--exclude, --exclude-from-report, --exclude-from-test, -p in place of --workspace, another --manifest-path) is measured over other patterns, so a planted crate exclusion fails like a file one (2.1-M217)

files..cargo/config.toml:
[alias]
cov = "llvm-cov --workspace --exclude canopi-desktop --exclude-from-report=canopi-types --exclude-from-test canopi-core -pcanopi-a --package canopi-b --manifest-path other/Cargo.toml --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex rust_engine/comparison\\.rs --fail-under-lines 88.2 --fail-under-functions 77.1 --fail-under-regions 87.9"
